notes: The supplied *not* was read as part of the recast verb's rendering — dropping it reverses the sense of הֶעְתִּיקוּ, so what would be lost is that verb's own lexeme (rules 43, 44 by subtraction); the competing reading marks it added under rule 34.
מֵהֶם is wholly unrendered, so the preposition and its suffix each go unrepresented (rule 40).
